game_updates.title: Community Update #7 – Releases on September 7th!
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Mercenaries!Community Update #7 is on its way, and we need your help to put its upcoming features to the test!Starting August 5, the Open Beta will be available to all Wartales players.A Free Update for All PlayersCommunity Update #7 will be released as a free update on September 7.How to Join the Open BetaRight-click Wartales in your Steam Library.Select Properties.Open the Betas tab.Select the Open Beta branch from the drop-down menu.Launch Wartales and begin your journey!If you want to opt out, follow the same process and select the game's default branch.ːsteamthumbsupː Savegame ManagementWe recommend using your own Wartales save file. To avoid any complications, we strongly advise creating a backup of your save file. It can be found here: Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Wartales\\...

game_updates.title: Update Notes August 5th
game_updates.contents: - SUMMER PARTY EVENT! Summer Party skins have returned to the event quest section for summer celebrations! - A new Emote system is added to lobby! Let your characters express a set of emotions while hanging out in lobby - Added new Creator program contents, including new Azrael skin and Creator badges - Badges can now be equipped directly in profile and lobby - Added a section on user-generated content to the publish rules for profile and artbook images - Fixed some situations where unlock conditions for characters / skins did not trigger - The dev-level 6 trust score is removed now, instead the official devs can now be recognised by their Acureus Team badge. - Some network optimisations - Various UI optimisations

game_updates.title: 30 DAYS LEFT!
game_updates.contents: As part of the 8AM series, this new entry takes players into a warehouse environment where observation, attention to detail, and quick decision-making are essential. Players will monitor camera feeds, identify anomalies, and report anything that should not be there before the situation escalates.With only one month remaining until release, we invite you to add 8AM: The Warehouse to your Steam wishlist and follow the game to stay updated ahead of launch.Thank you for your continued support.

game_updates.title: Apex Legends™: Marked Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: INTROWelcome to the latest season of Apex Legends: MARKED. In addition to Bloodhound’s rework, buffs to Loba and Rampart, an energy weapon systems overhaul, and brand new Corrupted Attachments, we’re also bringing you a World’s Edge map rework, quality of life tweaks, and a slew of balancing changes. All of this is in pursuit of evolving Apex Legends into the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. This season is going to push you and your squad to be the best you can possibly be, so get ready to group up, gear up, and dive into MARKED when it drops on August 4th, 2026!MATCHMAKING TESTSIn Season 29, we ran two matchmaking tests — 1-Tier Premade Restrictions and Diamond+ Solo-Queue-Only — to experiment with variables to potentially use to address player frustrations in Ranked. game_updates.title: v0.4.6: Gamepad Support + Optimization
game_updates.contents: Hey everyone,Special Customer UpdateWe planned to release gamepad support at the end of June, and release special customers in mid-late July. Gamepad support took a lot longer than expected, but we've been working on the special customers update in parallel, so it's not far off now. It's shaping up really nicely, and I think it'll be well worth the wait! Here's a sneak-peek of one of the customer groups:We're very excited (and relieved) to be launching gamepad support - this has been underway since last year, and has been shockingly more involved than initially thought. Every menu and input interaction in the game had to be rebuilt or significantly altered. We didn't want to do a quick and dirty implementation, so we've created a number of new systems to get the game 'feeling good' with a ...

game_updates.title: PAYDAY 2: Engine Upgrade Open-Beta - Extension
game_updates.contents: Hello HeistersThis is just a quick announcement to say the open-beta for the V3 engine will be extended to further weed out the oddities we've been getting reports on. We are now aiming to release out of beta on the 13th of August 2026.If you've been having issues recently please do make a post about it in the open-beta bug reporting subforum!As a reminder when the beta is complete anyone already in the open-beta will be able to play immediately, anyone not in the beta will need to update.

game_updates.title: Beta Patch Notes - v0.110.0
game_updates.contents: Another beta patch just dropped! This one contains a host of balance changes and reworks. Notably, Mirage and Pillar of Creation have been reverted back to their pre-0.109.0 versions and have also been slightly buffed and nerfed, respectively. We've also implemented a brand new feature in this patch--a keyboard-only control option! So be sure to let us know what you think if you try it out. In terms of art, many cards have new, polished portrait art and, excitingly, characters now have VFX for their unique forms! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971832/5241bdca8e33580f7b3ba5361221225407ec551c.gif CONTENT & BALANCE: Ancients: Buffed Neow's Abundance card: Now always creates Upgraded powers Upgrade changed to lower Energy cost by 1 Reworked Tezcatara's Toasty Mittens relic: "At the start of your turn, E...

game_updates.title: Matchmaking Update
game_updates.contents: This update includes a revamp to how the matchmaking system works, as well as the introduction of a new matchmaking mode. You can now choose to play in Standard Mode (unranked), or the new Ranked Mode introduced in this update. STANDARD MODE Standard mode provides a lower-stakes way to play Deadlock with friends, without worrying about adjustments your Rank. There are no restrictions on party size or skill spread. You can also play in this mode to practice heroes you are less familiar with, as the matchmaker will adjust the game it puts you in to account for your experience with that hero. RANKED MODE Ranked mode gives players a way to queue up for more competitive games against similarly-skilled players with higher stakes. Each season you'll be able to climb the Ranks and see how far you ...

game_updates.title: 3.26.3.5 Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: Yesterday evening we received report of a remote code execution (RCE) exploit in a malicious server's workshop mod. As a precaution, we temporarily disabled all Internet server listings while we prepared and released this patch. At this time, we believe the impact was limited to a single small server.Our sincere thanks to celeb for reporting the exploit, to Jdance for creating a proof-of-concept test case (initially reported through the community Discord), and to Daniel Willett for running a scan of the past month of workshop uploads to check whether this exploit had been used anywhere else (fortunately, it was not)!FixedPrevent loading components with UnityEvents connected to static methods.
